REQUIRED DOCUMENTS FOR THE APPLICATION
DOCUMENTS REQUIRED 
FOR ALL APPLICANTS
Academic Transcript of Records from Home University
CV (resumé)
Copy of the Student Card, or Student Certificate
Portfolio –  obligatory only for courses that are marked in the 
course offer at FMC
ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTS REQUIRED 
FOR ERASMUS STUDENTS
Online Learning Agreement (OLA)
ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTS REQUIRED 
FOR FREEMOVER STUDENTS
Student Application Form (SAF)
Learning Agreement (LA)
LANGUAGE CERTIFICATES Not required, recommended level of English B2

Information sheet – Exchange studies 2026/2027
PRACTICAL INFORMATION
ACCOMMODATION Halls of Residence
  Possibility to be accommodated in the Halls of Residence 
(HoR). Online registration and booking deposit 
(4 500 CZK) payment are required in advance.  
Admitted students will be informed and instructed before 
the application window for HoR opens.
ESTIMATED MONTHLY EXPENSES Accommodation (HoR)  
(Price list valid from  
July 2025) 
4,200 – 7,290 CZK
(depending on the facility and room)
Food 4,000 CZK
Entertainment 1,000 – 5,000 CZK
Total 8,900 – 16,290 CZK / month
OTHER EXPECTED EXPENSES Booking deposit (HoR) 4,500 CZK*
Visa application fee 2,500 CZK**
Mandatory  
Medical Insurance  
(for one semester – 5 months)
6,000 – 12,000 CZK** 
depending on the insurance company
* paid only once and refunded at the end
** applicable only to non-EU citizens
FOOD Possibility to have breakfast or lunch at University 
Refectory for student friendly prices (from 70 to 130 CZK).
VISA Not required for nationals of:
 European Union 
 Iceland
 Norway
 Lichtenstein
 Switzerland  
Required for:
 All other nationalities
More information on visa available online
